summary: the gnu suite's ntpd row on x86-64, with faults in the row's configuration and in the SNTP server; both scripts run as they are, so nothing is built

argv: ARCH=x86_64 RACH2_GNU_ROWS=ntpd exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run gnu 'gnu-test: ntpd: OK'

faults.name: no-server
faults.summary: the row writes /etc/ntp.conf with its server line commented out, so init starts no ntpd and the clock is never set

lines: gnu-test: ntpd: FAIL: no answer within its bound

faults.name: host-time
faults.summary: the SNTP server serves the host's own time in place of the time that began in 2030, so ntpd keeps the clock near the host's
